fiveStepWorkflow.name: Admin Creates the KPM & Prints Document
fiveStepWorkflow.actions: Input rute muatan, PIC, material items, generate KPM & cetak lembar fisik Triple QR

fiveStepWorkflow.name: Driver Logs In & Prepares Cargo
fiveStepWorkflow.actions: Scan QR ID badge, pilih batch muatan 1 truk di ponsel, foto bak truk & minta izin Gate Out

fiveStepWorkflow.name: Gate Checker Authorizes Exit (Gate Out)
fiveStepWorkflow.actions: Scan QR 2 (Tengah), cek fisik muatan vs foto supir, 1-klik izin seluruh batch (<30 detik)

fiveStepWorkflow.name: On the Road & Live Fleet Radar
fiveStepWorkflow.actions: 1-Klik navigasi Google Maps, background streaming GPS tiap 10s, radar satelit kantor real-time

fiveStepWorkflow.name: Arrival & Frictionless Recipient Handover
fiveStepWorkflow.actions: Scan QR 3 tanpa login/app, pilih nama, foto bukti bongkar material, 1-klik konfirmasi selesai
